messages:
maria: Quick sync  we're standardizing route headers. New compact header `x-rd-route` will be introduced. Need SDK changes and console mapping. RFC at github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/82

kevin: Will do. Plan: add RD_ROUTE_MODE env var and ClientConfig flag in py/ts/go. Default false initially.

sylvia: Console note: dashboards group by decoded route string. We need a canonical key to avoid split metrics. Can platform emit a stable `route.id`?

jonathan: Yes  routing will write `route.id` into traces and metrics. Also emitting `route.header_variant` for the transition.

maria: Server will accept both headers for 90 days. SDKs should ship opt-in minor, then flip default after canary validation.

kevin: I'll draft devex guide and code examples (py/ts/go). Will list exact versioning and rollback steps.

infra-bot: Canary deploy started: router-service v2025.1.0-canary -> staging (5%) at 2025-01-14T11:00:00Z

sylvia: I'll queue a backfill job for historical metrics to map old keys to `route.id`, and add a console banner during migration.

maria: Action items: devex guide (@kevin), platform emit `route.id` (@jonathan), console backfill/banner (@sylvia). Keep PR links here. :thumbsup:
